svg.title: AmiWind shared sky: measured build comparison
svg.desc: Across 2664 exterior maps, 301751 local sky enclosure render faces were removed and none remain. Aggregate disk storage including the one shared sky resource fell by 131.324 MiB. This is a build measurement, not a gameplay screenshot or a RAM or frame rate result.

g.text: One sky, less geometry in each cell
Map files + one shared sky resource, compared with the original exterior set.
Disk storage only · not RAM or FPS · playable-build acceptance remains open
